findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before checking its exceptions
findings.body: The reader thread can still be executing a groups request when deletedAll is set and caughtExceptions is asserted. If that in-flight request fails, it can add its exception after the assertion, allowing this regression test to pass despite the concurrency failure it is intended to detect. Keep a reference to the thread and join it before asserting; stop and join it in a finally block as well, since a deletion failure currently leaves the reader looping indefinitely and issuing requests during later tests.
